tied_from.description: the top entries of the list tied to it

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

DiffLine.title: DiffLine
DiffLine.description: One line of code in a before or after block. n is the line number in that version of the file.

text.title: Text

rest.title: Rest
rest.description: "3 lines added and 1 removed, proof passed"

FixLine.description: The one line on a failed result that has a fix in the Fixes step.

line.title: Line

FolderChangeBody.title: FolderChangeBody
FolderChangeBody.description: Rename, move or archive. Only the fields sent change (move to the top level with parent_id null).

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Always sent by the current backend; optional so an older reply doesn't break the screen.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Plain sentences about what the upload started on this computer (for example the demo test servers). Only on the upload reply.

assessment_id.title: Assessment Id
assessment_id.description: Phase 5a: the assessment this import belongs to.

settings_title.title: Settings Title
settings_title.description: The heading of the settings list, e.g. "System settings from the file".

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Settings rows the file carries (not claims: nothing checks them). Optional: older stored answers may lack it.

ImportSetting.title: ImportSetting
ImportSetting.description: One settings row from the file, e.g. location "localhost:8451", text "Exposure: internet-facing. Data lifespan: long-lived."

plain.title: Plain

also_noticed.description: Side notes about things the test saw that it wasn't asked about. Never a result.

code_line.title: Code Line
code_line.description: "Code they ran on: before, ...; after, ..." (before/after view only).

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: When grouped, already ordered group by group, in the order of `groups`.

busy.title: Busy
busy.description: Something is running for this file (tests, a retest or a proof in Fixes): ask again in a second.

before_note.title: Before Note
before_note.description: The second line under each heading: which code that side ran on.

before_heading.title: Before Heading
before_heading.description: The headings of the opened details.

plain.title: Plain

also_noticed.title: Also Noticed
also_noticed.description: Side notes about things the test saw that it wasn't asked about. Never a result.

real.description: True when the component is a real library, not one of our demo components (phase 4c).

fix_line.description: Not sent here: a measurement has no fix line.

advisories.description: Phase 4c: advisories for this version (null for our own demo code).

MeasurementResult.title: MeasurementResult
MeasurementResult.description:
A result as the Migration step and a change box's try show it: the same as a test's result, but its code can
also be a measured post-quantum status (found by the phase 4c+ check of every answer against its shape).

needs_reason.title: Needs Reason
needs_reason.description: True: Save stays disabled until the reason has text.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: The first is the row label column.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: One cell per column after the first.

MigrationLine.title: MigrationLine
MigrationLine.description: A sentence that may be followed by "View in Fixes" (when fix_id is set).

highlighted.title: Highlighted
highlighted.description: The sky border (the recommended or chosen one).

not_offered.title: Not Offered
not_offered.description: When set: no Choose button, this sentence instead.

choose.description: The box that opens in the card when "Choose this option" is pressed.

download.description: The same evidence download as Evidence Lab's button.

help.title: Help
help.description: The small grey question under the control.

source.title: Source
source.description: "from the file" | "assumed" | "set by you": a small tag beside the control.

MigrationStatus.title: MigrationStatus
MigrationStatus.description: The status pill. Its look is picked by code; the words are the label.

measuring.description: Set while this system's measurement waits or runs (drawn in place of Today's sentence).

options.title: Options
options.description: In the order keep, hybrid, full_pq, wrap. Empty when there is no status.

choice.description: The user's saved choice (history: older choices, newest first).

evidence_link.title: Evidence Link
evidence_link.description: "See the evidence": opens the details disclosure above and scrolls to it.

none_text.title: None Text
none_text.description: Shown instead of reasons when there is no recommendation.

result.description: Drawn with ResultDetail inside a closed disclosure.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Phase 4d: the third view, the dependency list.

busy.title: Busy
busy.description: True while measuring: ask again every second.

empty_text.title: Empty Text
empty_text.description: Set when the file names no server and no signing program.

page.title: Page
page.description: The page that holds the next thing to do, e.g. "inventory/import", "tests".

NotTested.title: NotTested
NotTested.description: The "Not tested, and why" box: every target or test the plan leaves out, one line each.

PlanGroup.title: PlanGroup
PlanGroup.description: A heading the cards (or Evidence Lab rows) are grouped under, e.g. "Server: localhost:8444".

has_migration.title: Has Migration
has_migration.description: A migration measurement exists for this plan (the Fixes step opens for it too).

grouped.title: Grouped
grouped.description: True when the file has more than one server or signing program: cards are drawn under group headings.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: In display order. Sent even when not grouped (the screen then ignores them).

tests.title: Tests
tests.description: When grouped, already ordered group by group, in the order of `groups`.

ProofCell.title: ProofCell
ProofCell.description: A result badge and one line under it, as in Evidence Lab's before/after cells.

before.description: the first result this is compared with

proof.description: null while this test has no proof result yet

waiting.description: set while it is waiting or running

control.title: Control
control.description: the control line under the proof cell

check.description: "Passed", "No slowdown", "Same as before", "Did not pass", "Not finished yet"

title.title: Title
title.description: "Why it is ready for review" | "Why this change is not offered"

shows_title.title: Shows Title
shows_title.description: "What this proof shows, and what it doesn't"

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One plain sentence: what was found and why that gives this result. Shown on top of the row.

also_noticed.title: Also Noticed
also_noticed.description: Things the check saw that the file didn't ask about. Side notes, never a result. Often empty.

component.title: Component
component.description: Which library this version belongs to (phase 4c).

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: true: the Demo data label follows the name

mode_line.title: Mode Line
mode_line.description: The sentence under the header saying how software is run, written by the backend.

SkippedItem.title: SkippedItem
SkippedItem.description: Something in the file that this version doesn't check (for example a hash algorithm).

StrongLabel.title: StrongLabel
StrongLabel.description: "Before: " + strong + rest, e.g. lead "Before:", strong "acme-sign 1.4.2", rest ", nothing removed here".

group.title: Group
group.description: The key of the group this card is under, when the plan is grouped.

TextSuggestion.title: TextSuggestion
TextSuggestion.description: The fuller text-only suggestion. Words between backticks are names: fixed width, never broken across lines.

path.title: Path
path.description: The folders above this one, top first.
